alphabet.title: Final prospectus, 6,000M euro senior notes (priced November 2, 2026)
alphabet.detail: Final terms as read from the prospectus supplement: floating rate notes due 2028, 750M euro at compounded EURIBOR plus 0.720 percent; 750M at 2.300 percent due 2028; 1,250M at 2.700 percent due 2030; 750M at 3.000 percent due 2032; 750M at 3.350 percent due 2035; 750M at 3.700 percent due 2039; 1,000M at 4.000 percent due 2045. Settlement November 5, 2026; net proceeds about 5,925.3M euro for general corporate purposes. These final coupons differ from the November 2 term sheet figures recorded in the October entries below; the final prospectus governs and the term sheet record is flagged for recheck.

alphabet.title: Pricing term sheet: 6,000M euro of senior notes in seven series priced
alphabet.detail: The euro offering launched the same day priced at 6,000M euro in seven series, settling November 5, 2026: a 750M euro floating rate series due 2028 at three-month EURIBOR plus 0.50 percent, and fixed rate series of 750M euro at 3.700 percent due 2028, 1,250M euro at 4.050 percent due 2030, 750M euro at 4.250 percent due 2032, 750M euro at 4.500 percent due 2035, 750M euro at 4.875 percent due 2039 and 1,000M euro at 5.250 percent due 2045. Ratings Aa2 from Moody's and AA+ from S&P. The preliminary supplement is accession 0001193125-26-442515.

Alphabet launched a euro-denominated senior unsecured notes offering in seven series, one floating rate series priced off three-month EURIBOR and six fixed rate series, in minimum denominations of 100,000 euro. The preliminary supplement leaves aggregate principal, coupons and maturities blank; net proceeds are stated for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of outstanding debt. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, BNP Paribas and Deutsche Bank.
alphabet.title: Preliminary prospectus supplement for euro senior notes offering

alphabet.detail: Leases not yet commenced carry future payments of $130.5B, primarily data centers and energy infrastructure. Future funding and support commitments to unconsolidated variable interest entities rose to $31.9B, including $10.0B of data center and energy backstops behind Crux AI, the joint venture with Blackstone formed in May 2026. Long-term debt of $125,102M after $80.8B of note issuance in 2026.

Thirty-Fifth Supplemental Indenture dated October 29, 2026 (Exhibit 4.1).

Ten series priced on October 29, 2026 for settlement on November 4, 2026: floating rate notes due 2028 and 2029 of $1.0B each at Compounded SOFR plus 35 and 53 basis points, and $23.0B of fixed rate notes with coupons from 4.850% due 2028 to 6.350% due 2066.
